sources.usage: Offline embedded Chinese Simplified subset TTF (renamed 'JZKLocal' Regular 400, bold synthesized), base64-inlined directly inside <head><style> of every CN HTML deliverable (report/proposal.html, visual/index.html). Subsetted to exactly 1060 non-ASCII codepoints = union charset of all CN deliverables (cmap verified missing=0). Format = TTF/truetype to guarantee glyph registration in wkhtmltopdf/QtWebKit preview containers that DO NOT support WOFF2; no remote @import / <link> / system CJK font dependency. Zero external fetches.
sources.upstream_work: Noto Sans SC chinese-simplified-400-normal (Regular weight only; Medium/Bold inlined elsewhere but CN HTML uses only the single 400 face + synthetic bold to avoid wkhtmltopdf dropping multi-face rules.)
sources.publisher_or_author: Google Inc. / Adobe (upstream Noto Sans SC project, OFL 1.1); subset rebuild & renaming to JZKLocal by participant (OFL §3 Reserved Font Name compliance: 'Noto Sans SC' name not retained in distributed derivative)
sources.url_or_local_path: Inlined base64 TTF data: URIs inside <head><style> of CN HTML deliverables (no binary file shipped). Upstream source: jsdelivr @fontsource/noto-sans-sc@latest — chinese-simplified-400-normal.woff2 → decompressed WOFF2→TTF via fontTools, subsetted, renamed.
sources.license_or_reuse_boundary: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Derivative work: subset + rename (family name changed to JZKLocal, Reserved Font Name 'Noto Sans SC' not used in derivative. Embedded TTF bytes (base64) distributed inside submission HTML under OFL 1.1 terms. Full license text: report/copyright_statement.md (present in submission package).
sources.verification_status: Subset glyph coverage verified: 1060 non-ASCII codepoints from union charset; subsetted TTF cmap contains all codepoints (missing=0). Format = TrueType (not WOFF2) to ensure wkhtmltopdf/QtWebKit preview renderers load glyphs instead of drawing .notdef boxes (□). Previous WOFF2-only renders were rejected by the offline preview container format support list and returned tofu in 2 prior review cycles; v6 eliminates that root cause.
sources.pagination_or_segment: Single subset TTF embedded (base64) in each CN HTML; no external font binaries shipped. English deliverables keep their original Latin-only system font stack (Helvetica/Arial/system-ui) and do not load JZKLocal CSS bytes.
